paper_explicit.statement: Eq.1 assigns valid proposals R_difficulty + w_sub K + w_div |A| and invalid proposals reward 0. Rule-based validity filtering controls whether an example enters the solver training pool; rejected proposals are not solver examples.
paper_explicit.implementation_implication: Invalid proposals remain zero-reward entries in the proposer reward group. Do not remove them from proposer GRPO normalization. Test that zero-reward invalid samples cannot gain a positive reward-relative advantage when all valid rewards are nonnegative; preserve valid samples with negative advantages.

paper_explicit.statement: Eq.5 gives final-state match reward 1/0; Eq.6 averages whether each reference subgoal was reached in any visited solver state and is set to zero when K=0; Eq.7 gives reward 1 for final success and otherwise the subgoal fraction.
paper_explicit.implementation_implication: w_sub=0.3 is the proposer Eq.3 coefficient for subtask count. It is not an extra multiplier on the solver's Eq.7 subgoal fraction.

paper_explicit.statement: For ALFWorld/ScienceWorld: four outer loops; 25 proposer and 25 solver steps per loop; proposer exploration budget 30 turns; max solver turns 30; context length 40,960; GRPO group size 16; G_P=8 solver rollouts per proposed task; 16 rollouts per training step; batch size 16; LoRA r=32, alpha=32; AdamW lr 1e-4; clip 0.3; KL 0.001; w_sub=0.3; w_div=0.3; 8×H100.
paper_explicit.reference: Appendix D / Table 3, paper PDF p.15
limits: The precise runtime meaning of batch size 16 and gradient accumulation is not fully operationalized in the table.
The table does not uniquely fix training temperature, max generated tokens, decode stop semantics, or all RNG details.
8×A800 is not performance-equivalent to 8×H100 by assertion.

training.global_group_semantics: global G=16 is one group; with 8 ranks shard 2 trajectories/rank. TPS remains 1; never increase it to world size as an implicit fallback.
verifier_acceptance: typed entity matching ignores instance suffix only while preserving cross-fact entity binding
final-state success, partial subgoal fraction, K=0 and no-finish/rejected-task branches
visited-state matching and conservative task-relevance/object-mention filters with counterexamples
training.learning_signal: Record group rewards/advantages, finite policy-gradient and KL components separately, active-adapter parameter delta and cross-rank equality. Equal group rewards imply zero reward-normalized policy-gradient advantage, but a nonzero KL gradient can remain if policy differs from reference.
training.invalid_proposer: Zero reward stays in proposer GRPO group; validity filter excludes rejected proposal from solver pool. No winner-only data selection.
